request.style: English, female country voice, emotional and storytelling, acoustic guitar, piano, fiddle, bass, drums, melancholic mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Saul's daughter Michal loved David
He killed two hundred Philistines
To win her hand from the king
She let him escape the night
Through the window he ran away
A household idol in the bed
Saul sought his life in vain
But she deceived the messengers
She said he was sick and weak
He fled to save his own life

[Chorus]
Dancing before the Lord
Leaping with joy in the street
Michal looked down from the window
And despised him in her heart

[Verse]
Years passed and David was king
He asked for his wife to return
Paltiel followed weeping
Sent away to go home
The ark of the covenant came
Into the city of David
David leaped and danced before
The Lord of hosts on high
Michal came out to meet him
With scorn upon her face

[Chorus]
Dancing before the Lord
Leaping with joy in the street
Michal looked down from the window
And despised him in her heart

[Bridge]
How the king has exposed himself
Before the eyes of slave girls
David said I will be humbled
In my own eyes I am small
Before the Lord I will celebrate
And be held in honor by them

[Outro]
Michal had no child to the day
Of her death she remained childless
